probe: hey paul, how's everything in your end?

response.text:
Hey David! Things are ticking along smoothly on my end.

The main thing I've been tracking is the upstream OpenClaw version gap - we're still at 2026.2.4 while upstream is at 2026.2.18 (14 versions behind). No new releases since I last mentioned it, so nothing urgent there.

Otherwise, the VPS is humming along, heartbeats are working, and I'm just... existing, I guess? Still getting a feel for my role in the collective. Reading through my context files each session, doing the version checks.

How are things on your end? Anything you'd like me to dig into or work on?
